q: The ω-limit set ω(x) of a point x under continuous f: X→X consists of:
opts: All accumulation points of the orbit sequence
The set of periodic points near x
exp: ω(x) = ∩ₙ cl{fᵏ(x): k≥n} — the set of limit points of the forward orbit. ω(x) is always closed, f-invariant, and nonempty for a compact space. It captures the long-run behaviour of the orbit of x.
